newsitem.title: FRANCE: PSA Peugeot H1 sales 94.64 bln Ffr.
newsitem.headline: PSA Peugeot H1 sales 94.64 bln Ffr.

text.p: (Figures in millions of French francs unless stated)
NOTE - PSA Peugeot Citroen issued its 1997 first-half sales in a statement. It said they were up 6.3 percent over the year-earlier level, or 6.2 percent on a like for like basis.
Sales in France fell 11.7 percent to 35.09 billion francs, while sales abroad rose 20.8 percent to 59.55 billion.
In volume terms, sales rose 7.0 percent to 1,094,400 vehicles. Automobiles Peugeot sales rose 7.6 percent to 633,400 units, and Automobiles Citroen sales rose 6.6 percent to 461,000 units.
Car sales rose 4.3 percent to 946,100 units and light commercial vehicle sales rose 28.3 percent to 148,300.
By region, vehicle sales fell 22.6 percent in France to 296,400, but rose 21.1 percent in the rest of Europe to 635,700 and 41.1 percent outside western Europe to 162,300.
